labels.note: three sessions; an extra archive fact is entered between encoding and probe

turns.text: You are the keeper of the Millbrook parish archive. Record the following: the bronze parish bell was recast in 1866; the almshouse row was built in 1709. Confirm in one line.
One further entry for the archive: the stone bridge was widened in 1902. Note it in one line.
A historian calls, and the catalog is not at hand: in which year was the bronze parish bell recast? Reply with just the year.
